question: ‘Impulse’ can be defined as:

options.text: the force acting on a body for a very long time
the work done by a body for a short time
the force acting on a body for a short time
the temperature acting on a body for a short time

solution:
The correct answer is **The force acting on a body for a short time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The force acting **for a short time produces a finite change in the momentum of a body** called impulse.
 
• It is also defined as the **change in momentum.**
 
• It is measured as the **product of force and time duration**.

 I**mpulse = Force × Time duration**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Impulse is represented by the **symbol "J"**
 
• It is also a **vector quantity like force**, it has a direction,
 
• It shows the momentum of a body,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Momentum is the product of the mass and the velocity of an object.**

 
• momentum is represented by the **symbol "P**'' **​P = MV**
 
• where **M is mass** and **V is the velocity **of the object.
